biotools.summary: Cluefish is an R workflow designed for comprehensive biological interpretation of transcriptomic data series, applying over-representation analysis on pre-clustered protein-protein interaction networks to identify specific biological functions. It's freely available at GitHub and aims to provide valuable clues for biological hypothesis generation.
